title: Church Discipline and Restoration
definition: Church Discipline and Restoration is the loving correction of sin in the Church for repentance, holiness, protection, and restoration.
summary: Church Discipline and Restoration is the biblical process of correcting serious sin with the aim of repentance, protection, and restoration.
christFocus: Jesus Christ loves His Church enough to correct, cleanse, and restore His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on loving correction when sin threatens the soul and the witness of the church. Discipline is not revenge, embarrassment, or power; it is a serious act of obedience designed to call a person back. Restoration remains the goal whenever repentance is granted.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because unaddressed sin harms individuals, victims, and the congregation's witness. At the same time, harsh discipline can misrepresent Christ's mercy. This doctrine keeps holiness and restoration together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Take sin seriously before it reaches public crisis. If correction comes, respond with humility rather than defensiveness. Churches should practice discipline slowly, biblically, prayerfully, and with tears.
